The preregistered symmetry-strengthened full-domain DTS SAT formula added complete row lexicographic ordering and per-row reflection breaking while preserving the frozen scope-111 decision problem. Kissat 4.0.3 returned `UNKNOWN` after `119.34` solver seconds on `15,570` variables and `2,383,982` clauses, with no model. Primary and flat-counter verification both rejected the empty decode. The tested symmetry omissions are not sufficient to resolve this encoding; close the route as Level 1 runtime evidence and require a materially different construction or capability.
The scoreboard is derived; evidence remains in append-oriented records and raw artifacts.
Heilbronn search is blocked because the protected baseline coordinate transcription conflicts with the primary PDF; do not edit protected files autonomously.

The pinned k-server evaluator is operational in WSL2 with a fork wrapper. The pinned n=7 seed has 5 taxi violations, while the explicit published n=5 candidate reproduces at 3 taxi violations and 0 complete-circle violations under both the primary evaluator and an independent direct array-inequality count; the count-3 result is prior art, not novelty.

After forty-four substantive experiments, a complete 1,001-node circle screen tested 29 one-row cyclic-orbit and sign-flip index_matrix variants around the 5-violation upstream seed. Only the unchanged matrix scored 0; non-control variants scored 24 to 984. No taxi follow-up was justified; practical local matrix variation is closed and all three directions are paused or blocked pending a materially different capability or mechanism.

Experiment 45 used native C++ two-word masks and a one-million-row random Golomb catalogue; the combined run reached depth 4 at 16,521 nodes with no witness. Experiment 46 separated the phases and generated the same catalogue in 4.37 seconds, but static rare-difference branching reached only depth 5 at 1,796 nodes in 240 seconds. Random-catalogue exact-cover search is therefore closed; a DTS revival needs on-demand constraint-generated rows or a different structural decomposition.

The published n=5 k-server candidate was reproduced at 0 complete-circle and 3 taxi violations by both the pinned primary evaluator and an independent direct count. The exact +/-1 neighborhood of its ten coefficients then produced 18 to 24718 taxi violations for all 20 non-controls; local coefficient repair is closed and no target candidate was found.

A 16-feature symmetry-aware additive work-function correction was infeasible under all complete-circle constraints even when targeting any pair of the three residual taxi edges. This closes the tested low-dimensional correction cone; one full-coordinate diagnostic is allowed before requiring a nonlinear or envelope-level mechanism.

The full 126-coordinate additive repair was also infeasible for all three or any pair of residual taxi edges under all complete-circle constraints. Additive linear correction is closed; the next k-server test must change the envelope operation itself.

Thirty max/min envelope switches using three documented canonical alternatives all passed the complete-circle screen, but taxi counts were 3, 14, 17, or 588; no switch improved on prior art. The next diagnostic is finite arbitrary difference-constraint feasibility, not more envelope offsets.

The five declared sparse LP models for arbitrary finite taxi-graph potentials all reached the 300-second HiGHS limit without a primal solution. This is inconclusive rather than infeasible; use a specialized relaxation/cycle certificate once before closing the finite-fitting route.

The specialized integer relaxation converged in 39 passes for all five systems. The no-removal table has zero violations under an independent all-edge audit and the pinned taxi evaluator, but only 105 of 1001 complete-circle nodes match; arbitrary finite table fitting is therefore overfit and the k-server route is paused absent a compact transferable rule.

DTS experiment 55 exhaustively closed the clamped published-witness one-row replacement family: the only consistent fixed-six case visited 108 partial rows and had zero complete compatible rows. Experiment 56 state-conditioned on-demand generation reached six disjoint rows on two of three seeds, but no seventh row or scope-111 witness appeared. Experiment 57 exact-pair completion found no disjoint final pair in the visited depth-five prefixes. Experiments 58 and 59 exhaustively closed the clamped witness repair basin through two and three changed rows: six consistent fixed-five cases yielded 16 rows and 20 pair checks with zero pairs; 16 consistent fixed-four cases yielded 1,732 rows and 6,896 triple checks with zero triples. All reported finite results were independently rechecked; no DTS target witness exists in these tested families.

Experiment 60 ran a full-coordinate NumPy differential-evolution search on the source-faithful Heilbronn configuration with three declared seeds. Every run retained the published construction at float64 precision; independent 100-digit Decimal evaluation found all 220 triangles but no strict improvement. This closes the tested global-DE family at its declared budget, not Heilbronn in general.

Experiments 61 and 62 encoded the complete DTS scope-111 decision problem as a preserved 15540-variable/1461683-clause one-hot CNF and ran two materially different CDCL solvers. Kissat 4.0.3 returned UNKNOWN after 119.57 seconds; CaDiCaL 2.1.3 returned UNKNOWN after 120.17 seconds real time. Neither emitted a model, independent verification found no rows, and neither result implies global DTS infeasibility. The exact full-domain SAT portfolio is closed at this encoding and budget; state is WAITING_FOR_CAPABILITY.

Experiments 63 and 64 tested a new DTS memetic family and then its exact shallow neighborhood. Three native fixed-seed runs converged to the same internally valid 103/105 state with duplicate differences 10 and 21, improving the clamped anchor's 100/105 proxy but not the target. Exhaustive enumeration of all 3,885 one-coordinate and 7,330,995 two-coordinate replacements over all 35 nonzero mark positions found 4,187,558 internally valid cases and no state above 103. Both independent integer verifiers rejected the best state. This closes the tested memetic basin through two coordinate changes without implying global infeasibility; state remains WAITING_FOR_CAPABILITY.

Experiments 65 through 67 applied exact row-packing decompositions to the same 103/105 state. Full row-0 replacement found zero compatible rows after 108 nodes; three-row replacement against fixed rows 1, 3, 5, 6 generated 84 compatible rows and no disjoint triple; four-row replacement against fixed rows 1, 3, 5 generated 9,644 compatible rows and no disjoint quadruple after 180,037 packing nodes. All searches completed without timeout and no target candidate was produced. These closures cover the tested one-, three-, and four-row repair classes only; global DTS infeasibility remains unproved and state remains WAITING_FOR_CAPABILITY.
